criteria.text: With a committed changed test, a nonzero old-code exit containing the literal "defect-x" and a zero new-code exit produce a successful old-code proof and exit 0.
If the old code passes, or fails with "other-error" instead of "defect-x", the report distinguishes "old-passes" from "wrong-reason", includes the observed wrong-reason excerpt and exits 1.
If the new code fails, the report says "head-fails" and exits 1 even when the old code fails with "defect-x".

Each phase requests a 120-second limit, a 2-second process-group kill grace and a 1 MiB output cap; base timeout, head timeout, output overflow and signals have distinct unsuccessful reports and exit 1.
No changed test gives "no-changed-tests"; missing commits, unsafe overlay setup and known missing-fixture/import failures give "setup-error" even when their output contains "defect-x"; none exits 0.

The proof selects committed regular added, modified or renamed tests and supplemental files under the documented test/fixture convention, ignores deleted files and implementation, and uses separate base and head snapshots.

The saved result keeps run/base/head identity, the exact command and expectation, selected paths, both phase exits, final output lines and the observed error excerpt even when it precedes those final lines; allocated snapshots are cleaned up even after a failed comparison.
The quoted command "node --test test/new.test.mjs" and expectation "defect x" reach the proof unchanged; missing, duplicate or blank options and extra operands exit 2 before proof execution.
